title: Pact Escrow
summary: Create a program-owned SOL escrow PDA, then release the amount to the seller. Refund (seller-signed) was not exercised in the lab proof.
what: Pact is a no_std pinocchio program (not Anchor): instruction 0 creates and funds a program-owned escrow PDA, 1 releases the amount to the seller by direct lamport debit, and 2 refunds the buyer. Because the PDA is program-owned, release does not need a signed system transfer.
app_note: The page at /dapps/pact-escrow/ is a small custom wallet console for this pinocchio program (not the generic Anchor IDL console). The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/pact-escrow (Blockchains/pact is a different Tempo project). declare_id was replaced with a unique lab program; pinocchio's nostd_panic_handler! was replaced so the crate builds on current platform-tools rustc.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/pact-escrow/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet, and fetch the lab escrow (seller GpUq5UH3…, seed 20261115) or create a new one with a fresh seed.
try_steps.see: Program BA6gPuCD…. Lab escrow 3xNd7gWF… should be Released, with 1_061_720 lamports of rent still in the PDA and the seller paid 1_000_000.

diagram: buyer --create_escrow (ix 0)--> escrow ["escrow", buyer, seller, seed] (program-owned, rent + amount) ; buyer --release (ix 1)--> seller +amount (rent remains)
accounts: escrow (seeds ["escrow", buyer, seller, seed u64 LE], owner = this program, 81 bytes)
innovation: A tiny pinocchio (no_std) SOL escrow whose PDA is program-owned, so release can debit lamports directly.
frontend: Custom Sol.College wallet console for this pinocchio program (esm.sh @solana/web3.js).
exercises: Fetch the lab escrow and confirm status is Released.
Explain why this release can debit the PDA when Guild's original vault debit could not.
Sketch a close instruction that returns remaining rent to the buyer.
not_covered: refund was not exercised. The escrow PDA is not closed after release (rent remains). v2 instructions in instructions_v2.rs are not the deployed entrypoint.
objectives: Locate the pact escrow PDA and the tokens it controls.
Walk the create → fund → release (or cancel) flow on the hosted app.
Read a successful transaction and name the instruction that moved funds.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds.
Basic familiarity with SPL token accounts.
student_outcome: Open a pact escrow and follow the release path using the recorded accounts.
